name: repostspace
description: AWS re:Post Private is a private version of AWS re:Post for enterprises with Enterprise Support or Enterprise On-Ramp Support plans.

subcommands.name: batch-add-channel-role-to-accessors
subcommands.description: Add role to multiple users or groups in a private re:Post channel.

subcommands.name: batch-add-role
subcommands.description: Add a role to multiple users or groups in a private re:Post.

subcommands.name: batch-remove-channel-role-from-accessors
subcommands.description: Remove a role from multiple users or groups in a private re:Post channel.

subcommands.name: batch-remove-role
subcommands.description: Remove a role from multiple users or groups in a private re:Post.

subcommands.name: create-channel
subcommands.description: Creates a channel in an AWS re:Post Private private re:Post.

subcommands.name: create-space
subcommands.description: Creates an AWS re:Post Private private re:Post.

subcommands.name: delete-space
subcommands.description: Deletes an AWS re:Post Private private re:Post.

subcommands.name: deregister-admin
subcommands.description: Removes the user or group from the list of administrators of the private re:Post.

subcommands.name: get-channel
subcommands.description: Displays information about a channel in a private re:Post.

subcommands.name: get-space
subcommands.description: Displays information about the AWS re:Post Private private re:Post.

subcommands.name: list-channels
subcommands.description: Returns the list of channel within a private re:Post with some information about each channel.

subcommands.name: list-spaces
subcommands.description: Returns a list of AWS re:Post Private private re:Posts in the account with some information about each private re:Post.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns the tags that are associated with the AWS re:Post Private resource specified by the resourceArn.

subcommands.name: register-admin
subcommands.description: Adds a user or group to the list of administrators of the private re:Post.

subcommands.name: send-invites
subcommands.description: Sends an invitation email to selected users and groups.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates tags with an AWS re:Post Private resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the association of the tag with the AWS re:Post Private resource.

subcommands.name: update-channel
subcommands.description: Modifies an existing channel.

subcommands.name: update-space
subcommands.description: Modifies an existing AWS re:Post Private private re:Post.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: channel-created
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query channelStatus returns CREATED when polling with ``get-channel``.

subcommands.name: channel-deleted
subcommands.description: Wait until ResourceNotFoundException is thrown when polling with ``get-channel``.

subcommands.name: space-created
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query status returns CREATED when polling with ``get-space``.

subcommands.name: space-deleted
subcommands.description: Wait until ResourceNotFoundException is thrown when polling with ``get-space``.
